clips.name: Jerome Powell
clips.text: You know, it's, the investment we're getting in equipment and all those things that go into creating data centers and feeding the AI, it's clearly one of the big sources of growth in the economy.

clips.name: Kevin Warsh
clips.text: You see market participants that are discriminating between the kinds of investments they want to make. You've seen credit spreads for certain assets widen out, gap out.
